title: Northwind — Pipeline Health
description: Whether the warehouse can be trusted right now: row counts against expectations, unresolved foreign keys, outstanding inferred members, and how far behind the CDC watermark is. A dashboard showing revenue is worth nothing if nobody is watching whether the numbers behind it are complete.

panels.title: Fact rows
panels.description: Expected 2155 for the unmodified Northwind sample.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS fact_rows FROM v_FactOrders_Current

panels.title: Unresolved product keys
panels.description: Facts pointing at product_key 0, meaning the lookup found nothing and no inferred member was created. Should always be zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS unresolved FROM v_FactOrders_Current WHERE product_key = 0
SELECT count() AS unresolved FROM v_FactOrders_Current WHERE customer_key = 0

panels.title: Inferred members
panels.description: Dimension stubs created by the fact load and not yet enriched. A few are normal between dimension runs; a number that keeps growing means the dimension load is not keeping up.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM v_DimProducts_Current WHERE product_name = '') + (SELECT count() FROM v_DimCustomer_Current WHERE company_name = '') + (SELECT count() FROM v_DimEmployees_Current WHERE full_name = '') AS stubs

panels.title: Tombstoned facts
panels.description: Rows marked deleted by CDC. Kept rather than removed so a delete stays auditable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS tombstoned FROM FactOrders FINAL WHERE is_deleted = 1

panels.title: Historical dimension rows
panels.description: Closed SCD type 2 versions. Growth here is the history being kept, not a problem.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM DimProducts FINAL WHERE end_date != toDateTime('2106-01-01 00:00:00')) + (SELECT count() FROM DimCustomer FINAL WHERE end_date != toDateTime('2106-01-01 00:00:00')) + (SELECT count() FROM DimEmployees FINAL WHERE end_date != toDateTime('2106-01-01 00:00:00')) AS closed_rows

panels.title: Dimension row counts
panels.description: Current rows against the expected count for an unmodified Northwind. A mismatch here is the first thing to check when a figure elsewhere looks wrong.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name, actual, expected, if(actual = expected, 'OK', 'MISMATCH') AS status FROM (SELECT 'DimGeography' AS name, (SELECT count() FROM DimGeography FINAL) AS actual, 135 AS expected UNION ALL SELECT 'DimShippers', (SELECT count() FROM DimShippers FINAL), 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'DimTerritories', (SELECT count() FROM v_DimTerritories_Current), 53 UNION ALL SELECT 'DimSuppliers', (SELECT count() FROM v_DimSuppliers_Current), 29 UNION ALL SELECT 'DimCustomer', (SELECT count() FROM v_DimCustomer_Current), 91 UNION ALL SELECT 'DimProducts', (SELECT count() FROM v_DimProducts_Current), 77 UNION ALL SELECT 'DimEmployees', (SELECT count() FROM v_DimEmployees_Current), 9 UNION ALL SELECT 'FactEmployeeTerritories', (SELECT count() FROM FactEmployeeTerritories FINAL), 49 UNION ALL SELECT 'FactOrders', (SELECT count() FROM v_FactOrders_Current), 2155) ORDER BY status DESC, name

panels.title: Storage and merge state
panels.description: Parts per table. ReplacingMergeTree deduplicates during background merges, so a high part count means reads without FINAL may still see duplicates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT table, sum(rows) AS rows_on_disk, count() AS parts, sum(bytes_on_disk) AS size FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND active GROUP BY table ORDER BY rows_on_disk DESC

panels.title: Orders loaded per month
panels.description: Distribution of what is actually in the warehouse. A month that suddenly empties points at a load that failed rather than at a quiet month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.full_date) AS time, uniqExact(f.order_id) AS orders FROM v_FactOrders_Current AS f INNER JOIN DimDate AS d ON d.date_key = f.order_date_key GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
